$comment: Spike S2 evaluation set for the §5.2 resolution ladder's embedding-match rung. Entities are real exported symbols and types from /home/kiel/dev/houseworks/src, extracted by shallow ripgrep (a tree-sitter spine is the next phase's job); glosses are one-liners written from each symbol's own docblock. Queries cover three phrasings the ladder must survive: the exact symbol name, alias-style casing near-misses (kebab/snake/spaced), and vague natural-language descriptions ('the auth thing' shape from §5.2). Ground truth is a single entity id per query; queries whose correct answer is genuinely ambiguous between two entities were excluded rather than guessed.

entities.name: splitByWeight
entities.gloss: Splits a price across weighted shares using floors plus largest remainders, with ties broken by member id.

entities.name: presenceMs
entities.gloss: Milliseconds of an accrual window during which a member was present, after merging their away spans.

entities.name: settleLines
entities.gloss: Builds settlement lines from finished instances with their payer shares and doer shares.

entities.name: computeNets
entities.gloss: Computes each member's net balance across all settlement lines in a period.

entities.name: simplifyDebts
entities.gloss: Reduces net balances to a minimal set of payments between members.

entities.name: aggregateVotes
entities.gloss: Aggregates members' reservation-price votes into a task template's base price by min, mean or median.

entities.name: currentPrice
entities.gloss: Pure function computing an instance's price from its template, window anchor and the clock, capped at maxPrice.

entities.name: elapsedDaysFractional
entities.gloss: Fractional days elapsed between two instants, floored at zero.

entities.name: deriveState
entities.gloss: Derives whether an instance is cooling, available, in progress or credited at a given time.

entities.name: hasLiveSessionElsewhere
entities.gloss: True when a member already holds an in-progress session on some other instance.

entities.name: releaseSession
entities.gloss: Clears a live or lapsed session from an instance as if the session never happened.

entities.name: revertReprice
entities.gloss: Undoes an agreed repricing as a whole: engine pricing back, doer binding cleared, start-by deadline dropped.

entities.name: lapseReprice
entities.gloss: Lapses a repricing whose start-by deadline passed without the bound doer starting.

entities.name: hasLiveStartBy
entities.gloss: True while an approved repricing's start-by deadline still binds its doer.

entities.name: isAbandonedPosting
entities.gloss: True for an ad-hoc posting left pending with no open negotiation behind it.

entities.name: potentiallyBound
entities.gloss: The members whose wallets a proposed set of terms could bind, always minus the proposer.

entities.name: awaitedNamedPayer
entities.gloss: True when the terms name a member as a payer and that member's acceptance is still outstanding.

entities.name: moves
entities.gloss: Projects the consent law from one viewer's seat into three descriptive and five permission booleans for a negotiation.

entities.name: expire
entities.gloss: Marks a pending negotiation expired from the instant its expiresAt passes, and is a no-op before then.

entities.name: voidAsMoot
entities.gloss: Voids a pending negotiation that stopped mattering through nobody's decision.

entities.name: applyTerms
entities.gloss: Applies agreed negotiation terms to an instance: consent locks, price fixes, payer rule transfers.

entities.name: applyUplift
entities.gloss: Applies an agreed uplift to a credited line, raising the doer's credit above the cleared price.

entities.name: counter
entities.gloss: Records the single permitted counter-proposal on a negotiation, constrained to move price toward the countering side.

entities.name: withdraw
entities.gloss: Withdraws a pending negotiation on the proposer's own initiative.

entities.name: makeApp
entities.gloss: Composes every use case over the injected ports; the application layer's entry point.

entities.name: makeMemoryUow
entities.gloss: In-memory unit of work adapter holding house-scoped repositories, used by tests.

entities.name: createPostgresUow
entities.gloss: Postgres unit of work adapter that opens transactions against the hwm database.

entities.name: makeHttpServer
entities.gloss: Node HTTP server adapter that exposes the contract over the network.

entities.name: makeHandler
entities.gloss: Builds the request handler routing contract endpoints to application use cases.

entities.name: makeControllableClock
entities.gloss: Test clock adapter whose current time is set explicitly rather than read from the system.

entities.name: systemClock
entities.gloss: Clock adapter reading the real wall-clock time from the host.

entities.name: uuidIds
entities.gloss: Identifier generator adapter producing UUIDs for new records.

entities.name: devIdentity
entities.gloss: Development identity adapter resolving the calling member from a request header.

entities.name: makeFsEvidenceStore
entities.gloss: Evidence store adapter persisting uploaded photos to the filesystem.

entities.name: makeMemoryEvidenceStore
entities.gloss: Evidence store adapter holding uploaded photos in memory.

entities.name: noopPublisher
entities.gloss: Publisher adapter that discards every domain event it is handed.

entities.name: TaskInstance
entities.gloss: One unit of work-as-expense with a doer side that earns the cleared price and a payer side that owes it.

entities.name: HouseConfig
entities.gloss: House-wide standing terms such as period length, timezone and session factors.

entities.name: TaskTemplate
entities.gloss: A recurring chore's standing terms: voted base price, accrual per day and maximum price.

entities.name: AwaySpan
entities.gloss: An exact-timestamp interval during which a member was absent from the house.

entities.name: SettlementLine
entities.gloss: One instance's contribution to a settlement: its cleared price with payer shares and doer shares.

entities.name: EvidenceAttachment
entities.gloss: Append-only link from an instance to a photo, tagged before, after or extra, and never removed.

entities.name: UnitOfWork
entities.gloss: Port opening a transaction that hands house-scoped repositories to a use case.

entities.name: AppError
entities.gloss: The domain's error type carrying one of the enumerated error codes.

entities.name: pence
entities.gloss: Constructor for the branded integer-pence money type used throughout the domain.
